// Minimal real stdio MCP server. It never calls a network service.
import { createInterface } from 'node:readline';
import { appendFileSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
const delay = Number(process.env.FIXTURE_DELAY || 0);
const log = process.env.FIXTURE_LOG;
if (log) appendFileSync(log, `start:${process.pid}\n`);
process.on('exit', () => { if (log) appendFileSync(log, 'exit\n'); });
createInterface({ input: process.stdin }).on('line', async line => {
  const message = JSON.parse(line);
  if (!('id' in message)) return;
  if (log) appendFileSync(log, `${message.method}\n`);
  let result;
  if (message.method === 'initialize') {
    if (delay) await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
    result = { protocolVersion: '2024-11-05', capabilities: { tools: {} }, serverInfo: { name: 'fixture', version: '1.0' } };
  } else if (message.method === 'tools/list') {
    if (process.env.FIXTURE_AUTH_PATH) {
      const stored = Object.values(JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.FIXTURE_AUTH_PATH, 'utf8')))[0];
      for (const level of ['info', 'warning', 'error']) process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({
        jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'notifications/message',
        params: { level, data: { configured: process.env.API_TOKEN, access: stored.tokens.access_token, refresh: stored.tokens.refresh_token } },
      })}\n`);
      if (log) appendFileSync(log, 'notifications-sent\n');
    }
    result = { tools: [{ name: 'get_metric', description: 'Get Datadog fixture metrics', inputSchema: { type: 'object', properties: { fail: { type: 'boolean' } }, additionalProperties: false } }] };
  } else if (message.method === 'tools/call') {
    if (message.params.arguments?.fail) result = { isError: true, content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Fixture metric read failed' }] };
    else result = { content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'fixture metric:42' }] };
  } else result = {};
  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: message.id, result })}\n`);
});
